name: create_order
description: Create a sales order for a customer. ONLY call after the customer has explicitly confirmed the items and quantities. Scheduled/controlled items are never ordered. Prescription-only items may be ordered only when search_product showed prescription_on_file=true (the customer sent a verified prescription photo); otherwise ask the customer to attach the prescription photo. For pickup, branch_id is required and must have stock; for delivery, the system picks a branch with stock.

errors.when: any item is a scheduled/controlled medicine — never ordered via the agent
a prescription-only item has no verified prescription photo for this customer — ask for the photo
requested qty unavailable at the required/only branch
customer_id or a product_id does not exist
missing branch_id for pickup or delivery_address for delivery
